Credit growth of about 19 per cent was another positive indicator, particularly for credit markets.

facts.text: Rs 200 lakh Crore Investment Opportunity in the Power Sector in Next Two Decades Demands Teamwork of all Stakeholders: Shri Manohar Lal 27 NOV 2026 12:40PM by PIB Delhi The two-day Power Ministers’ Conference commenced in New Delhi today.

The conference (November 27-28, 2026) brings together Power Ministers, senior officials and electricity regulators from 28 States and 8 Union Territories and is chaired by Shri Manohar Lal, Union Minister of Power and Housing & Urban Affairs.
The last such conference at the national level was held in 2024.
The Minister noted that the country’s power sector presents investment opportunity of Rs 200 lakh crores over the next two decades, and all stakeholders have to work together to make this possible.
